title: Observables for cyclic causal set cosmologies
relevance: Defines R_p as covariant events exhaustive for infinitely-post dynamics, proves R_p=tildeR_p intersect R, and investigates complex-percolation extension on doubly-reduced poscau.
limits: Read targeted full-text sections II.1, III.4, V and VI; paper's labelled-tree extension analysis is inconclusive and does not prescribe values on covariant-only events.
version: arXiv:2212.01149v2, submitted 2023-07-17; page identifies title and 2026-08-24 manuscript date
locators: Sec. II.1 Eqs. (1)-(2); Sec. V Eqs. (29)-(31), Theorems 14-15; Sec. VI Lemma 16
assumptions: Sequential-growth labelled histories; covariance under order-isomorphism; post-cyclic algebra defined by requiring all or none of non-post histories.
conclusion: The covariant post algebra is the intersection of the doubly-principal cylinder sigma algebra with the covariant event algebra. The complex-percolation extension test on doubly-reduced poscau is stated to be inconclusive.
proof_status: Paper proves algebra identity and tree criterion; no proof of covariant-only complex-measure nonexistence.
open_questions: What values, if any, should a complex measure on R_p assign to covariant post events? Does an independent post-value rule force nonexistence?
dependencies: Complex-measure extension criteria cited from Dowker, Johnston, and Surya; used as comparison only.

title: On extending the Quantum Measure
relevance: Proves bounded-variation obstruction for complex percolation on labelled cylinder algebra and discusses covariant events and post-event conditional convergence.
limits: Targeted full-text read of Sec. 4 and relevant discussion; the post event is discussed as requiring its own prescription, not given the prescription in BOUNDARY.md.
locators: Sec. 4, Eqs. (42)-(48), discussion around lines corresponding to post observables and conditional convergence
assumptions: Complex percolation transition amplitudes on sequentially labelled causal sets; extension to full generated sigma algebra tested through bounded variation.
conclusion: The labelled amplitude premeasure lacks bounded variation for non-real percolation parameters; full complex measure extension fails. Covariant event prescriptions can require conditional convergence.
proof_status: Authors give labelled-algebra proof and discuss interpretation; does not establish the proposition in BOUNDARY.md.
open_questions: Can a natural covariant-only event prescription be selected without invoking the full labelled measure?
dependencies: Hilbert-space-valued measure and bounded-variation framework cited in the paper.

title: A Criterion for Covariance in Complex Sequential Growth Models
relevance: States that labelled finite-stage events are not covariant, formulates the extension/bounded-variation criterion for complex sequential growth, and applies it to complex percolation.
limits: Targeted full-text read of Secs. 1-3; extension statements concern the full labelled sigma algebra and do not fix covariant post-event values.
locators: Sec. 1 covariance setup; Sec. 2.3 extension criterion; Sec. 3 extension and complex-percolation examples
assumptions: Sequential growth histories with finite labelled causal-set cylinders; complex measure valued in the scalar Hilbert-space case.
conclusion: Full-sigma extension is tied to bounded variation; complex percolation fails the full-algebra extension except on the real probability interval.
proof_status: Theorem/proof in paper for the stated full-algebra criterion; no covariant-only post extension theorem.
open_questions: Whether a smaller covariant event algebra admits a measure without a full labelled extension remains distinct from the paper's criterion.
dependencies: Independent-edge random graph order / transitive-percolation model.

title: A Computation of the Expected Number of Posts in a Finite Random Graph Order
relevance: Derives the classical infinite-random-graph-order post probability and the future-side Euler product used as the real-parameter renewal comparison for the stationary post-factorization premise.
limits: Targeted full-text read of Sec. 2, Theorem 2.1 and Eqs. (1)-(2); real 0<p<1 only. It neither studies complex amplitudes nor covariant-only measures.
locators: Sec. 2: definition of lambda_k and kappa immediately before Theorem 2.1; Theorem 2.1 for Pr(k is a post); proof immediately following for the past-side finite product and future-side infinite product.
assumptions: One-way infinite random graph order on N with independent edge probability 0<p<1, followed by transitive closure.
conclusion: The probability a fixed element k is a post is lambda_{k-1}(q) kappa(q), with kappa(q)=product_{j>=1}(1-q^j); the future-side post probability is kappa(q).
proof_status: Authors prove the real-parameter formulas in Sec. 2; no complex continuation is considered.
dependencies: Independent-edge random graph order model; Alon et al. result is cited for the infinite-post almost-sure fact but was not independently read here.
open_questions: Whether the classical event-value factor admits a principled extension to complex measures on the covariant post algebra is not answered.
